The vendor directly operating and providing the **Macaly** platform at **macaly.com** is **LANGTAIL.COM s.r.o.**.

### Supporting Evidence
According to the official **AI Transparency Notice** on **macaly.com**:
> *"We are LANGTAIL.COM s.r.o., ID No. 198 68 987, with its registered seat at Záhřebská 562/41, Vinohrady, 120 00 Prague 2, Czech Republic... We operate the website available at macaly.com (the 'Platform' or 'Macaly') and provide the related services, applications, software, features, AI-powered tools and integrations accessible through the Platform..."*

The website's legal footers also confirm: *"Macaly by Langtail"*.
